Functions.Name: Abc_TruthGetBit
Functions.Original: static inline int     Abc_TruthGetBit( word * p, int i )         { return (int)(p[i>>6] >> (i & 63)) & 1;        }
Functions.Draft: func Abc_TruthGetBit(p *word, i int32) int32 { return int32((p[i>>6] >> (i & 63))) & 1;        }

Functions.Name: Abc_TruthSetBit
